notes: Employers buy listing packages priced in zloty net, for example 65 zł for 15 days. The partner page lists partner job portals where listings are published. No API, company owner or language options found on the pages read.

name: Jober.pl
business_model: free posting with paid featured and renewal options
notes: Posting is free. Paid packages are listed from 25 to 2000 PLN, and renewal costs 5 PLN. Parent company and API options were not stated on the pages read.

name: eRecruiter
ingest_methods: multiposting to job portals via integration;career site integration
notes: Homepage and pages state PL and EN options, monthly prices from 249 zl net, membership of Grupa Pracuj and an API integration mention. API access terms are not stated.

name: HireDoc
notes: Privacy page names ZnanyLekarz sp. z o.o. with its seat in Warsaw as operator and controller. Add-listing page offers a 90-day free listing. No language list, parent, API or partner page was found in the pages read.

name: Ogłoszenia ngo.pl
business_model: free basic listing, paid featured listings
notes: Footer says the portal is run by Stowarzyszenie Klon/Jawor. Regular listings are free and featured listings are priced for 7, 14 or 30 days. An English link is in the footer. No headquarters, API or partner information is stated.

name: Jobbsafari
notes: Homepage lists JobbSafari AB in Stockholm (first of three offices, the others in Helsinki and Norway). The site states it is part of Duunitori Group. An 'In English' link points to an English employer page. No employer prices, API or partner program found on the homepage or employer page.

name: Ledigajobb
notes: Employer page shows paid packages priced from 3 900 kr to 16 900 kr. Site is in Swedish with no language selector. No API or partner program is mentioned. The /api, /developers and /partners paths returned 404. The /annonsera path returned 404.

name: Jobmonitor
notes: Homepage shows an English language menu and 8,525 open jobs. Contact page gives no employer pricing, parent company or API statement.

name: Workey
notes: Aggregator. The about page says it collects jobs with automatic crawlers, open APIs and direct publishing, which describes how jobs come in, not an API offered to employers. Operated by a sole proprietorship (enskild firma). Employer pricing not stated; the contact page only offers to explain advertising.

name: Academic Work
notes: Swedish recruitment and staffing site for young professionals. Job listings in English are offered on a separate page.

name: Jobs in Stockholm
business_model: pay per ad, pay per click or yearly job slot subscription
notes: Terms page names 4Sight SPRL as owner and operator, with registered office in Brussels. Prices are in euros excluding VAT. No API, partner programme or language options found on the pages read.

name: StudentJob Sweden
notes: Homepage is in Swedish. Language selector, API and partner pages were not read.

name: MyCareersFuture
notes: Site header states it is a Singapore Government Agency Website. Homepage text is only 'Loading...' in the fetch tool and browser reader; /about and /employers return a page-not-found message.

name: OfferZen
notes: Self-serve marketplace charges a 12.5 percent pay-per-hire fee. Embedded recruiting and contracting use custom fees. No HQ, parent, API or board partner program was stated on the pages read.

name: JobMail
notes: Homepage and premium employer page state free posting, paid monthly accounts and an XML feed. The copyright line names Junk Mail Publishing (PTY) LTD, but the relationship is not described. No headquarters, language switcher, API or partner information is stated.

name: Salt Recruitment Jobs
niche: digital, creative, marketing, sales and tech

name: Bizcommunity Jobs
notes: Job listings page of Bizcommunity. The job posting page offers a monthly subscription.

name: Dubizzle Jobs
notes: Homepage is in English. The About Us and job posting pages returned HTTP 404 in the browser reader, so employer, company and API facts could not be checked on any working page.

name: Dubai Careers
notes: Employer portal of the Dubai government. Business model, API and partner options were not stated on the pages read.

name: Tes Jobs
notes: Jobs page footer states Tes Global Ltd is registered in England with its registered office in Sheffield; this is the registered office, not a stated head office. Advertise page describes a subscription for unlimited job adverts. No API or partner page was found in the pages read.

name: Teach Away
notes: Recruitment portal for teachers. Recruitment subscription with a one-time annual fee, amount not shown. Post uncapped job listings year-round. No API, partner or headquarters statement found in pages read.

name: Sheryan (Dubai Health Authority)
notes: Portal homepage describes health providers posting vacancies. No prices or API statement was found on the pages read.

name: Sharjah Department of Human Resources job seekers service
Ras Al Khaimah Careers
notes: Job portal listing jobs from employers in Ras Al Khaimah. The language menu offers English (United Kingdom) and Arabic. No employer pricing, API, parent company or ingest method stated on the home and contact pages read.

name: karriere.at
notes: Imprint lists offices in Linz and Wien, Austria; the imprint does not say which is the head office. Employer ad products start at EUR 949 per ad (Standard, 30 days). No language switcher, developer, API or partner page was found in the pages read.

name: alle jobs (AMS public job search)
notes: Public job search of AMS Österreich, free for job seekers. Per the AMS help page, listings come from a crawler and from an employer interface called HR-API. No public developer API page or employer pricing found.

name: meinjob.at
notes: Operated by CM Classified Media GmbH, Vienna. Single job ads 159,00 to 259,00 EUR, packages 449,00 to 1.099,00 EUR per the products page. About page says the platform is part of the oe24 network. Platform credit reads Powered by Jobiqo. No API, partner or language switcher seen.

name: VDAB
business_model: free basic listings with paid formulas
notes: Dutch-language public employment service site. Employer page shows free posting and paid formulas, prices not shown. API Center page lists a Vacature Posting API and a request form. Language switcher options not seen in pages read.

name: Le Forem
notes: Employer page states online job posting is free. No language switcher or API page was found on the pages read.

name: Actiris
notes: Employer page describes posting vacancies through My Actiris. No prices, parent company or API statement was found on the pages read.

name: Student.be
notes: Employer site shows NL, FR and EN; the main site footer shows only NL. Credits from €60 per vacancy (€30 each at 10 credits) or a licence from €104 per month. API V3 docs require a Bearer key but do not say how keys are issued. Headquarters and parent not stated.

name: Xpatjobs
business_model: per post and pay per click
notes: Owned and operated by Armitage Global Ltd per the about page. Single job posting priced in euros; the advertise page lists pay per click and an XML feed in its plan table. No registered office address found on the pages read.

name: jobup.ch
business_model: free posting with paid visibility options
notes: Recruiter pages show FR and EN language links. Primary language and headquarters are not stated. Owner taken from the about page.

name: JobScout24
notes: Employer page offers free job posting with optional paid visibility options. Footer carries the copyright line of JobCloud, which the page does not describe as a parent. No API, partner or headquarters statement was found in the pages read.

name: Job-Room (arbeit.swiss)
notes: Federal unemployment insurance and public employment service portal. Vacancies are registered on Job-Room. No developer, API or partner page linked from the pages read.

name: jobwinner.ch
notes: Imprint lists JobCloud AG headquarters in Zurich and says Jobwinner belongs to JobCloud. Business model, API and partner pages were not found on this domain.

name: Jobnet
notes: Job-seeker portal. The footer names the Danish employment agency and gives a Copenhagen address. No employer pricing, API, language options, partner program or ingest method found on the home, find-job, support or help pages read.

name: WorkInDenmark
parent: Danish Agency for Labour Market and Recruitment
notes: Public employment service based in Odense, part of the EURES network. Its employer service is stated to be free of charge. No job posting API or partner programme found on the pages read.

name: The Hub
notes: Per-job prices of €99 (Basic, 30 days), €330 (Pro, 45 days) and €1.100 (Max, 60 days). Mesh Community acquired The Hub in 2022. No headquarters, language options, API or partner program found on the pages read.

name: job.dsr.dk
notes: Operated by the Danish nurses union. Footer shows a Copenhagen postal address, which is not recorded as headquarters. No language selector, pricing or API pages were read.

name: Duunitori
business_model: free basic listing or paid campaign per listing
notes: Operator Duunitori Oy in Helsinki. Basic listing is free; paid campaigns run 30 days (14 days for the lowest level). Site offers Finnish, English and Swedish job listings.

name: Työmarkkinatori
notes: Footer lists a Rajapinnat (interfaces) link, but its page could not be located, so no api_status is recorded. Homepage, English personal-customers page and footer read in the browser reader.

name: Valtiolle.fi
notes: Finnish state job search service. Home page links a Swedish and an English version. The privacy notice gives a Helsinki visiting address for the controller. No pricing, API or partner page was found in the pages read.

name: Kuntarekry
notes: Finnish job board for municipal and wellbeing-area employers. Homepage says the Kuntarekry service is produced by Talentech, which is not stated as a parent. No API, partner or pricing statement found in pages read.

name: Jobbnorge
notes: Language menu lists Norsk Bokmål, English, Norsk Nynorsk and Sámegiella (mapped to se, Northern Sami). Footer names Grade Jobbnorge AS with a Norwegian org. number. No prices, API or partner page was found in the pages read.

name: KarieR.co
notes: About page says listings are indexed from employer career sites and verified ATS systems, and that employers cannot buy higher ranking. No pricing, owner, headquarters or API page was found in the pages read.

name: Kampanje Jobb
notes: Employer page describes job ad packages without prices. The company postal address is on the parent publisher's kampanje.com site, which was not used as a source.

name: SAPO Emprego
notes: Employers can publish free job ads; the page also mentions premium solutions without prices. The employer page says a free API exists for publishing ads, but the key or access route is not stated. SAPO's about page says it was bought by the former Portugal Telecom, now MEO. Headquarters, language options and partner program not found.

name: Expresso Emprego
notes: Contact page says a job ad must be paid for before the weekly edition deadline. No language switcher, prices or API page was found.

name: IEFP iefponline
parent: Instituto do Emprego e Formação Profissional (IEFP)
notes: Portal is owned by the IEFP. Employers can post directly on the portal or pre-register an offer by form, after which a technician completes it. No fees, language options or API found on the pages read.

name: Landing.jobs
business_model: subscription, plus hiring fee on some plans
notes: Plans from €99 per month (Post Job Only) to €4.999 per month (Unlimited, no hiring fee). Sourcing and Scalability plans add hiring fees. The about page gives a Lisbon office address but does not label it headquarters. No API, language options or partner program found.

name: Úřad práce ČR vacancy listings (Jednotný portál MPSV)
Public Service Commission of Kenya portal
Trabajo, Empleo y Seguridad Social (Argentina government)
Agencia Pública de Empleo del SENA
Sistema de Información del Servicio de Empleo (SPE)
